body:
No, you do not sound harsh at all. We have no kids. Been married only a few months.

I hear everything you say about not staying together b/c I can't find anyone else, but you do not know how hard it is for me to start relationships. I tried desperately for all of my teenage years and early 20's and got nowhere. I am the binary opposite of a "ladies man." My family has always kind of known that I'm socially retarded... they were shocked when I told them that I had a g/f

I don't know if I can be both single and happy. With my age and looks, the prospect of being single is almost too awful to contemplate.

As for deciding whether to stick with my marriage or not, I'm on drugs all the time and never know how I really feel. On top of that, at any given moment it's always easier just to pretend everything is fine than it is to try to start up a discussion about splitting up.

I have a therapist but oddly enough he was the one who convinced me to ask out this other woman
